role: T24A audits the T19/T20 low-level append/insert surface in crates/mad-dom-bun/src/handle.rs and freezes it here; it adds no new native export, so no symbol is duplicated (per the T20A seam rule). Remove/replace belongs to T24B (mutation_remove_api); T24C builds the WHATWG Node.appendChild/insertBefore facade on this native surface

appendChild.behavior: inserts child as parent's last child through Core Document::append_child (the unified mutation entry); a child with a parent is moved, appending an already-last child is a no-op, and a DocumentFragment child is spliced (its children move, the fragment is emptied, an empty fragment is a no-op); returns undefined (the WHATWG return of the appended node is a facade adaptation)

insertBefore.behavior: inserts child immediately before reference, which must be a child of parent, through Core Document::insert_before; moving, fragment splicing, self/reference no-ops and error rules follow appendChild; a reference that is not a child of parent fails with ERR_MAD_DOM_HIERARCHY; returns undefined (the WHATWG return of the inserted node is a facade adaptation)

identity.rule: mutation returns void and mints no wrapper; the resulting tree is read exclusively through crate::handle::SharedDocument::wrap_node (the per-document weak wrapper cache, T20), so a moved or inserted node reads back as one and the same JS object while its wrapper is alive
identity.distinct: a fresh createElement/createText node is always a distinct node from any existing wrapper

delegation.rule: extensions delegate every tree operation to Core through crate::handle::with_document; no second DOM state; a Core NodeId is never fabricated and never crosses the boundary as a primitive; a failed operation leaves the tree byte-for-byte unchanged (Core validates every precondition before mutating)
delegation.noBindingTreeRules: the binding only converts NodeHandle arguments to their Core NodeId and propagates Core errors; every structural check and relation write happens in mad-dom-core

coverage.detached: a detached child (no parent) is appended as a normal child; appending a detached child with an existing subtree moves the whole subtree
coverage.moving: appending/inserting a node that already has a parent detaches it first and re-attaches it (reorder within one parent, or move a subtree between parents)
coverage.documentFragment: appending/inserting a DocumentFragment moves all its children to the target position and leaves the fragment empty; an empty fragment is a no-op
coverage.invalidHierarchy: a Document parent/child, a node inserted into itself or into one of its descendants, and a fragment whose child is the parent or an ancestor of it all fail with ERR_MAD_DOM_HIERARCHY (HierarchyRequestError) without changing the tree
coverage.wrongReference: insertBefore with a reference that is not a child of the parent (a live node in the wrong position, or a detached node) fails with ERR_MAD_DOM_HIERARCHY without changing the tree
